automatic_contracts: Menu, pause, options and inspection have initial focus and a working back path.
Power selection retains node identity and selection across pause/options.
Modal drawing order stays above raised power cards.
Actionable targets remain in the canvas; power titles fit their cards.
Solid button foreground/background text contrast is at least 4.5:1.
Illegal casts have no gameplay side effects; repeated input cannot double-cast.
Individual HP, upper/middle/lower targets and speed initiative remain legible with one to three actors per side.
Healthy reserves do not enter the active card cycle; incapacitated owners keep blocked cards.
Partial and hidden information never expose the secret enemy queue through preview, inspection or the test bridge.
Preferences and completed-run statistics persist after reload.
Reduced motion updates current cards and clears transient effects.
Particles and SFX voices are bounded; impact shake returns to rest.
Browser-input runs reach victory, capture, evolve, deploy reserves and show an actual three-versus-three battle; full-roster release is covered separately by rule tests.
No Godot runtime errors, empty test passes, or source changes during evidence capture.
Editing targets preserves card nodes; clearing or removing commands never spends a round, item or RNG.
Player plan and pile inspection expose no private enemy queue or future draw order.
Preparation stores visible charge and spends it only on the next damaging technique.
Starter selection begins with one individual and six owned cards; back cancels without a run.
Move nature is explicit; condition source/duration, species resistances and reaction names are inspectable.
Legal browser routes execute Brotação, Floração, Incêndio, Condução and electrical Interferência.
Capture explicitly chooses a vacant field slot or reserve; canceling preserves offers, individuals and RNG.
Entering reserve cards interleave with the remaining draw; exhausted draw recycles normally without guaranteed owner blocks or extra draws.
Own-command readout and last-round history expose no private future queue; touch can inspect powers through Plan.
Expedition map selection is pure, confirmation enters only reachable unfinished nodes and choosing one branch closes its alternative.
Checkpoints preserve exact stable battle cards, roster, committed plan and RNG; canceling New and practice leave the saved expedition intact.
Completed or replaced expeditions cannot resurrect from an older checkpoint; results count once and storage failures are surfaced.
review_questions: Em cinco segundos, consigo localizar HP individual, intenção, ações e a próxima escolha?
As criaturas e a arena têm prioridade visual, com textos sem colisões ou cortes?
Seleção, foco, erro e poder desbloqueado são distinguíveis sem depender só de cor?
O impacto comunica a ação e volta ao repouso rapidamente? Compare com movimento reduzido.
Captura, evolução, troca e reanimação explicam custo, alvo e timing antes da confirmação?
A melhoria atende ao objetivo desta iteração? Registre uma comparação concreta e qualquer regressão.
Que decisão tornou a partida mais interessante? Registre a hipótese de playtest; testes não provam diversão.
